hebrewText: כִּ֣י אֶת עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔/וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַ/נֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑/וֹ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ כְּ/י֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize
tokens.kjv: distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

tokens.bdb: properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
tokens.kjv: abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.

tokens.bdb: Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants
